annotation.title_clean: 民政部 人力资源社会保障部关于印发《养老服务师职业资格制度暂行规定》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Civil Affairs and Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security on Issuing the Interim Provisions on the Professional Qualification System for Elderly Care Service Professionals
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 民政部; 人力资源社会保障部 (Ministry of Civil Affairs; Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, China)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese ministerial notice issuing interim provisions that establish a three-level professional qualification for elderly care service professionals, covering exams, eligibility, competencies, certificate registration and continuing education. It mentions use of elderly care technology devices only in passing; it is not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates junior, intermediate and senior Elderly Care Service Professional qualifications listed in the National Professional Qualification Catalogue
National unified exams for junior and intermediate levels with a 60% pass mark
Defines competencies, including use of rehabilitation aids and elderly care technology products
Certificate registration run by the Ministry of Civil Affairs Social Welfare Center, with deregistration for misconduct
Effective on issuance; ends separate junior and intermediate professional title assessment in elderly care
